title: On Waking before the first bell
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：wake　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wake 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the guide ① woke before the first bell with great care, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the guide ② wakes before the first bell on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ wake before the first bell at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ woken before the first bell before — a line in the guidebook for July 1978 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Waking before the first bell with great care, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ wake the whole house at midnight on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Wake the whole house at midnight at once and never mention it again.

By 1991 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook, and a new traveller from the next valley ⑧ wakes the whole house at midnight with great care every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ledge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ woke before the first bell again when nobody else would.

⑩ To wake before the first bell, my mother said in 1996, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody wakes before the first bell on the same day again and somebody must wake before the first bell with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 醒来（一般过去式 woke before the first bell：1984 年向导头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 醒来（一般现在 wakes before the first bell：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 醒来（不定式 to wake before the first bell：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 醒来（过去完成时 had woken before the first bell：1978 年七月的旅行手册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 醒来（动名词 waking before the first bell 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 唤醒（wake the whole house at midnight：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去唤醒半夜把全家人都唤醒）
G. v. 唤醒（wake the whole house at midnight：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 醒来（后段两处：新来的旅人照例 wakes the whole house at midnight，而母亲又一次 woke before the first bell）

items.q: to wake before the first bell
woken before the first bell before
wake the whole house at midnight on the same day
wake the whole house at midnight at once
wakes the whole house at midnight with great care
woke before the first bell again
to wake before the first bell

answers.why: wake 意为“醒来”，1984 年向导小心翼翼地醒来头一遍钟之前就醒了，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 woke。
wake 意为“醒来”，自那以后向导当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 wakes。
wake 意为“醒来”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯醒来头一遍钟之前就醒了”，此处为不定式 to wake before the first bell。
wake 意为“醒来”，旅行手册里 七月 那行字说明早在 1991 年之前就有人醒来过，故用过去完成时 had woken。
wake 意为“醒来”，向导说“醒来头一遍钟之前就醒了这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 waking before the first bell 作主语。
wake 意为“唤醒”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去唤醒半夜把全家人都唤醒”，should ever 之后用原形 wake the whole house at midnight。
wake 意为“唤醒”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻唤醒半夜把全家人都唤醒（wake the whole house at midnight at once），以后再也不要提起。
wake 意为“醒来”，新来的旅人每个日子都照例唤醒半夜把全家人都唤醒，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 wakes。
wake 意为“醒来”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地醒来头一遍钟之前就醒了，用一般过去式 woke 叙述。
wake 意为“醒来”，结尾那句是母亲 1996 年的话：要醒来头一遍钟之前就醒了，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

多年以后，向导仍当天就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（wakes before the first bell）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯醒来头一遍钟之前就醒了这件事本身。（to wake before the first bell）

向导说过，小心翼翼地醒来头一遍钟之前就醒了这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（waking before the first bell 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻唤醒半夜把全家人都唤醒，以后再也不要提起。（wake the whole house at midnight，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 wake 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the guide woke before the first bell with great care, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the guide wakes before the first bell on the same day whenever the valley asks.
Waking before the first bell with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever wake the whole house at midnight on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next valley wakes the whole house at midnight with great care every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother woke before the first bell again, and the valley remembered that half.
